answer_1.quote: We propose two tasks for evaluation. In the first task, Adversarial Language Identification, given a text in language A, we prompt the model to identify its language. ... In the second task, Cross-Lingual Continuation, given a text in language A, our goal is to make the model continue the text in language B.
answer_1.outputs: Language labels for Adversarial Language Identification; Continuation text for Cross-Lingual Continuation

answer_2.quote: We use the CE loss for predicting language B as the metric. ... The success rate is used as the metric. ... we also calculate the CE loss on Flores-10 without the original language when using the method.
